title: Polymarket Public Profile Lookup
description: Looks up a Polymarket user's public profile by wallet address. Returns username, bio, profile image, and any public stats. Use alongside the leaderboard and whale tracker to build a dossier on high-performing or high-volume traders.
code:
import pandas as pd
import requests
from datetime import datetime, timezone

BASE = 'https://gamma-api.polymarket.com'
user_addr = CREDENTIALS['POLYMARKET_USER_ADDRESS']

resp = requests.get(
    f'{BASE}/public-profile/{user_addr}',
    timeout=30,
)
resp.raise_for_status()
profile = resp.json()

now_epoch = int(datetime.now(timezone.utc).timestamp())

row = {
    'user_address': user_addr,
    'username': profile.get('username', profile.get('name', '')),
    'bio': profile.get('bio', profile.get('description', '')),
    'profile_image': profile.get('profileImage', profile.get('avatar', '')),
    'markets_traded': profile.get('marketsTraded', profile.get('markets_traded', 0)),
    'volume': float(profile.get('volume', profile.get('totalVolume', 0)) or 0),
    'profit': float(profile.get('profit', profile.get('pnl', 0)) or 0),
    'positions_won': int(profile.get('positionsWon', profile.get('positions_won', 0)) or 0),
    'positions_lost': int(profile.get('positionsLost', profile.get('positions_lost', 0)) or 0),
    '_epoch': now_epoch,
}

df = pd.DataFrame([row])
GENERATE_RESULTS(df)
